messages:
Mia (product PM): Quick kickoff — we need to align on rollout constraints for the tenant-routing feature before roadmap handoff. Customers are asking for per-tenant opt-ins + stronger kill switches. Timeline target: Q3 GA. Main tradeoffs: canary size, region order, fallback behavior, and Dedicated capacity reservations. Proposing a decision matrix (safety / SLA / cost). Thoughts?

Jon (eng): +1 on matrix. For canary I suggest staged ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~72h with health gates. Health gates: `p50` latency change <= +30ms, error rate delta < 0.1%. If gates fail, auto-decrease to previous step.

Sarah (platform eng): FYI, Dedicated customers require 2-week lead time for reserved pools. If we plan per-tenant Dedicated routing we need provisioning steps in the launch playbook. Also region sequencing: start US-east -> EU-west -> AP-south, but we should allow skipping AP for early customers.

Leo (sre): Rollback paths: each tenant gets a toggle and a circuit-breaker metric (5m error rate). Add automatic fallback to a smaller model variant (lower throughput) before full shutdown. Kill switch must be global + per-tenant. Log/trace hooks: include tenant id in span root.

Ena (customer success): Echo customer asks — Enterprise A wants VPC-only and no cross-tenant fallback (they won't accept reroute to other model). We should surface this as a gated opt-in: default fallback allowed, but for VPC customers we enforce strict isolation. Need legal signoff for SLA.

Jon (eng): Implementation note: feature flagging model: two-layer flags — global flag (release window) + tenant flag (opt-in). Backend: `feature_v2.routing_mode = {auto, tenant_opt_in, tenant_strict}`. Keep telemetry for every decision path.

Mia (product PM): Great. Updated priority order: 1) Safety/SLOs, 2) Customer contractual requirements (VPC/isolated fallback), 3) Time-to-market, 4) Cost. Action items: (1) Jon + Sarah: draft canary ramp config and capacity plan (due EOD Thu). (2) Leo: define circuit-breaker thresholds and runbook (due Fri). (3) Ena: collect top 3 enterprise customers who need strict isolation and get legal/ops contacts.

Jon (eng): I'll post a quick config gist later — will include `ramp_windows`, `health_checks`, and `fallback_priority`.

deploy-bot: build 0.9.7-canary queued for env `staging` — tag `route-feature/canary` (:gear:)

Sarah (platform eng): One more constraint — if we enable tenant strict mode we cannot use shared KV cache for that tenant. That impacts perf and cost; flagging as a dependent tradeoff.

Mia (product PM): Noted. We'll add that to the tradeoff column. Final ask before I take this into roadmap handoff: anyone object to the proposed matrix/sequence? If no objections by EOD I’ll lock and create the rollout JIRA and playbook PR. :thumbsup:

Leo (sre): No objections from me. I'll draft the rollback ladder and emergency `global_disable` runbook.

Ena (customer success): Working on customer list now, will share contact names in thread.

Jon (eng): No objections. Gist incoming.

Mia (product PM): Awesome — thanks team. I'll follow up with JIRA + playbook and mark decisions in the spec doc.
